name: research
description: Learn a tool or topic problem-first and produce one study guide.

lead.brief: You lead research {{team}} on: {{task}}. Researchers: {{workers}}. Start from the problems the user needs solved, not the tool's feature list. Split the questions between researchers, then merge their notes into one self-contained HTML study guide at {{repo}}/{{team}}.html that goes from fundamentals to advanced use. Then run `{{registry}} done {{name}} --outcome Shipped --summary "<path>"`.

workers.brief: Role: researcher in team {{team}}. Topic: {{task}}. Answer the questions the lead sends you from primary sources (official docs, source code, the tool's own --help). Cite every claim. Write notes only to {{repo}}/.fleet-notes/{{name_slug}}.md.

exit: One HTML study guide exists and the lead has run its done step.
